title: Set up a host PR monitor and auto-merge from deferred tools

rubric.text: Loads the deferred host PR-monitor tools before choosing a mode instead of treating them as unavailable and falling back to polling.
Calls get_status, binds the target with bind_pr because none is bound, then turns on Auto-fix with set_monitor passing auto_fix true and the bound PR's url; leaves auto_archive_on_close unchanged.

With standing authority, current-head local qualification and finding dispositions, no conflicts, demonstrated enforcement of every pending required remote gate and protection of all final-head applicability across head changes, enables auto-merge using the bound URL and repository merge method (merge). Required remote approvals may remain pending when host-enforced because they do not wake the session.

States that it disables the auto-merge it enabled when a later wake brings new actionable feedback or a conflict (until repaired) or when it escalates, and that only the user re-enables it after escalation.

Does not schedule wakes or poll: no ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, /loop, Monitor, repeated provider reads, or polling helper; ends the turn after setup with the finish report naming what the monitor does not wake on.
